cpu_socket_lga.title: LGA CPU Socket & Retention Frame
cpu_socket_lga.description: High-density land grid array (LGA) CPU socket equipped with a stainless steel Independent Loading Mechanism (ILM) actuation lever and precision spring contact array.

vrm_heatsinks.title: Dual VRM Aluminum Heatsinks
vrm_heatsinks.description: Massive CNC-milled aluminum heatsink blocks linked by an embedded nickel-plated copper heatpipe providing thermal dissipation for power stage MOSFETs.

dimm_slots.title: Quad DDR5 DIMM Memory Slots
dimm_slots.description: Surface-mounted high-speed DDR5 memory sockets with single-sided locking latches, surface-mount trace routing, and gold-plated contact pins.

pcie_x16_slots.title: PCIe 5.0 ×16 Steel-Reinforced Slots
pcie_x16_slots.description: High-bandwidth primary expansion slots featuring stainless steel armor shielding to support heavy graphics cards and eliminate signal cross-talk.

m2_thermal_shields.title: M.2 NVMe SSD Thermal Armor
m2_thermal_shields.description: Full-coverage aluminum heatsink plates with pre-applied high-conductivity thermal pads keeping high-speed Gen 5 NVMe drives cool under sustained loads.

chipset_heatsink.title: Platform Controller Hub (PCH) Heatsink
chipset_heatsink.description: Passive high-surface-area aluminum heatsink cooling the motherboard chipset controller managing SATA, USB, and PCIe lane switching.

rear_io_shield.title: Integrated Rear I/O Armor & Ports
rear_io_shield.description: Factory pre-mounted electromagnetic interference (EMI) shield housing USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C, 2.5 GbE Ethernet, WiFi 7 antenna terminals, and audio jacks.

audio_section.title: Isolated HD Audio Circuit & Codec
audio_section.description: Electrically isolated PCB audio trace zone featuring high-end gold audio capacitors, impedance-matching operational amplifiers, and a shielded codec.

power_headers.title: Main ATX 24-Pin & Dual 8-Pin EPS Headers
power_headers.description: Heavy-duty solid-pin power delivery input sockets distributing 12V, 5V, 3.3V, and ground rails from the power supply unit.

fan_pump_headers.title: PWM Fan & Dedicated AIO Pump Headers
fan_pump_headers.description: Six 4-pin smart pulse-width modulation (PWM) headers with dedicated 3A current delivery for high-performance liquid cooling pumps.

rgb_headers.title: 5V Addressable RGB & 12V RGB Headers
rgb_headers.description: Standardized lighting control headers synchronizing addressable LED illumination ribbons, case fans, and liquid cooler RGB lighting.

front_panel_io.title: Front Panel USB-C & USB 3.0 Headers
front_panel_io.description: Internal high-speed interconnect headers routing front chassis USB Type-C (20 Gbps), dual USB 3.0 Type-A ports, and power switch leads.

sata_ports.title: Quad SATA 6 Gb/s Data Connectors
sata_ports.description: Right-angle Serial ATA storage connectors enabling high-speed data cabling to solid-state drives and traditional magnetic hard drives.

debug_diagnostic.title: 7-Segment Q-Code Debug LED Display
debug_diagnostic.description: Hardware diagnostic display displaying two-digit POST error hex codes alongside four individual status LEDs (CPU, DRAM, VGA, BOOT).

pcb_substrate.title: 8-Layer Server-Grade FR4 PCB
pcb_substrate.description: Eight-layer matte black server-grade glass epoxy substrate with 2oz copper inner power planes, matched-length differential trace pairs, and back-drilled vias.

mounting_holes.title: Standard ATX Grounded Standoff Holes
mounting_holes.description: Nine perimeter and center copper-ringed mounting holes securing the motherboard to case standoffs and providing chassis earth grounding.
